scripts.test: npm --prefix client run test && (cd server && pytest)
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && (cd server && ruff check .)
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose.dev.yml logs -f client server

scripts.obs:status: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose.dev.yml -f infra/compose.observability.yml -f infra/compose.observability.apps.yml ps
scripts.obs:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose.dev.yml -f infra/compose.observability.yml -f infra/compose.observability.apps.yml logs --tail 100 -f grafana loki tempo prometheus alloy
